notes.title: "Happy Monster" Playtest Version Launch Announcement
notes.content:
Dear players, we are thrilled to announce that "Happy Monster" is about to meet you all! Our first playtest version is scheduled to be released on October 22, 2024.

"Happy Monster" is a strategy role-playing game filled with adventure. In this game, you will transform into a brave little monster, crossing over to a different world dominated by an evil demon king. Here, you will embark on a journey full of challenges and adventures, exploring this new world filled with the unknown and danger. You will face various strange monsters, collect rare treasures, unlock unique genetic forms, gain powerful skills and talents, and ultimately defeat the powerful enemies of various biological tribes.

In the upcoming playtest version, we will open the first three levels of the story mode and five different difficulty levels of the challenge mode. Players will have the opportunity to experience six different characters, three of which need to be unlocked by completing specific story levels. In battle, you can enjoy a variety of weapons, physical techniques, and magical skills, as well as unique Dragon Might skills, which will help you survive and clear enemies in battle.

In addition, the game store will provide more than 30 skills and more than 150 props for players to choose from, adding infinite possibilities to your adventure journey.

We know this is just the beginning, and future versions will further improve the construction of the game's world view and enhance the artistic expression of combat. We plan to add more characters, skills, Dragon Might skills, and monster types, as well as introduce new features such as an achievement system and a bestiary system to make the player experience more colorful.

Due to the limitations of development time, the playtest version currently only provides Chinese and English language options, for which we apologize, and we promise to gradually add more language support in future updates.

We look forward to adventuring with you all in the world of "Happy Monster," exploring the unknown and challenging limits. Get ready, let's welcome the arrival of this fantastic journey together!

"Happy Monster" Development Team
